agent_role: Agent D - Candidate Union / Cross-Arm Auditor

candidate_universe.pair_directionality: directional role-bound identity; source and target are not normalized or alphabetically swapped
candidate_universe.reverse_pair_semantics: A reverse pair would be a distinct identity only if it independently satisfied the frozen source and target role sets. In the actual frozen universe the two role sets have zero identity overlap, so target-to-source role reversal is not an eligible reciprocal candidate.
candidate_universe.self_pair_policy: source == target is excluded by eligible_pair_records_v1; the frozen source and target identity sets are disjoint, so no self-pair subtraction changes the observed 12 x 12 = 144 count

top_k_policy.rationale: The numeric budget is preregistered by the C0 policy. A separate scientific rationale for choosing 20 beyond that policy was not established by this union audit.

union_algorithm.deduplication: Exact tuple-key de-duplication in an insertion-ordered dictionary
union_algorithm.stable_serialization: First encounter fixes cohort position: all new META pairs first in META rank order, then previously unseen STAT pairs in STAT rank order, then previously unseen GDN pairs in GDN rank order
union_algorithm.duplicate_handling_across_arms: Collapsed to one candidate while appending arm provenance and retaining each arm-specific rank/evidence binding

verified_primary_overlap.derivation_mode: Read and aggregate frozen public candidate identity and origin-arm fields; no arm ranking or discovery was recomputed
verified_primary_overlap.scientific_interpretation: Overlap is descriptive only. It is not evidence of correctness, quality, method superiority, relation confirmation, or a selection rule.

method_specific_evidence_preserved.META: arm rank, evidence tier, official-reference count and identifiers, binding hashes, result hash
method_specific_evidence_preserved.STAT: arm rank, selected horizon, sign, file-local coefficients, stability strength, ranking hash, result hash
method_specific_evidence_preserved.GDN: arm rank, edge-selection frequency, selected-seed count, aggregate learned-graph similarity, ranking hash, result and compatibility hashes

provenance_retention.origin_arms_order: canonical META, STAT, GDN subset order

downstream_handoff.handoff_object: CandidateProfilingCohortV1 identity list plus per-arm provenance

covered_boundaries: no merged score or global rank
self-hash, schema, cross-binding, and public privacy boundaries
tests.note: Existing test source and frozen reports were inspected; this agent did not run production or scientific code.

findings.finding: META top-20, STAT top-20, and GDN top-20 produce an exact 47-pair unscored union with complete per-arm provenance.
The union does not normalize or compare heterogeneous arm scores and does not create a global scientific rank.
First arm encounter controls serialization only; downstream profiling receives all 47 identity/provenance records as unconfirmed candidates.
The top-20 budget is preregistered and enforced, but this audit did not locate a separate scientific rationale for why 20 is preferable to another primary budget.

The integration builder's preliminary all-pairs set uses the raw source-target cross product, while the canonical helper uses the self-excluding universe. They are exactly equivalent for the frozen zero-overlap role sets, and the canonical helper still rejects any out-of-universe pair.

supported: Three arm-level top-20 candidate lists were integrated.
The frozen result is an unscored tuple-identity union of 47 candidates.
Per-arm provenance and arm-specific ranks/evidence were retained.
The cohort was handed to relation profiling as candidate identities, not confirmed relations.
not_supported: The union is a unified cross-arm ranking.
Higher serialization position is a scientific ranking.
A selected pair is a confirmed temporal or causal relation.
Any discovery arm is scientifically superior based on the union.

unknowns.item: Scientific rationale for selecting primary top-20 rather than another candidate budget
unknowns.impact: Future EXP-01 sensitivity and stability work should evaluate this policy choice without changing the frozen pilot.
